41501.meaningLit: first discourse on the person of no integrity

41503.meaningLit: first discourse on the quest for gratification

41506.meaningLit: first discourse on the abandoning of ignorance

examples.text: ālapanatthā dhike liṅg'atth'ābhidhānamatte ca paṭhamāvibhatti hoti.

41509.meaning1: youth; in the prime of life (up to age thirty-three)
41509.meaningLit: in the first stage of decay

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu daharo hoti yuvā susu kāḷakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo samayo padhānāya.

41510.synonym: ku, chamā, bhū, bhūma, bhūmi, bhūri

examples.text: aciraṃ vat'ayaṃ kāyo, paṭhaviṃ adhisessati, chuḍḍho apetaviññāṇo, niratthaṃ'va kaliṅgaraṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu paṭhaviṃ khaṇeyya vā khaṇāpeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
yaṃ kiñci, rāhula, ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ… yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pia kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ kakkhaḷaṃ kharigataṃ upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā paṭhavīdhātu

41517.meaning2: sap or essence of the earth

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto sevālapaṇakapariyonaddho. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya.

41527.meaning1: due to bending; caused by bending

examples.text: tadā paṇamya sirasā, katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ, gantvā disvā narapatiṃ, idaṃ vacanam'abraviṃ.
vicittasaṅkhāraparikkhitaṃ imaṃ, ākhyātasaddaṃ vipulaṃ asesato, paṇamya sambuddham'anantagocaraṃ, sugocaraṃ yaṃ vadato suṇātha me.

41531.meaning2: having bowed down, having adored, having worshipped

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo saṅgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ pharasuppahārānaṃ bheri-paṇava-saṅkha-tiṇava-ninnāda-saddānaṃ. evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
saṅkho ca paṇavo ca saṅkhapaṇavaṃ, gītañ'ca vāditañ'ca gītavāditaṃ, daddari ca ḍiṇḍimo ca daddariḍiṇḍimaṃ. evaṃ tūriy'aṅg'atthe.
seyyathā'pi, mahārāja, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno. so suṇeyya bherisaddam'pi mudiṅgasaddam'pi saṅkhasaddaṃ'pi paṇavasaddaṃ'pi dendimasaddaṃ'pi.
katena tassa etassa, paṇāmena visesato. ratanattaye visesena, visesassādarena me.
handa, kahaṃ pana tumhe āyasmanto gacchathā'ti? bhagavatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhusaṅgho paṇāmito'ti. tena'h'āyasmanto muhuttaṃ nisīdatha, app'eva nāma mayaṃ sakkuṇeyyāma bhagavantaṃ pasādetun'ti.
gacchatha, bhikkhave, paṇāmemi vo, na vo mama santike vatthabban'ti.

41537.meaning2: having dismissed, having ejected, having shut

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā kismiñci'd'eva pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇāmetvā pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram'ādāya kapilavatthuṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
niddaṃ tandiṃ vijambhitaṃ, aratiṃ bhattasammadaṃ, vīriyena naṃ paṇāmetvā, ariyamaggo visujjhatī'ti.

41538.meaning1: (of hands) having stretched out (in reverential salutation)

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udāneti
atha kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante paṭhame yāme, uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
atha kho so bhikkhu vihāraṃ pavisissāmī'ti kavāṭaṃ paṇāmento addasa sabbaṃ vihāraṃ ahinā puṇṇaṃ, vātapānehi bhoge nikkhante, disvāna bhīto vissaram'akāsi.

41542.synonym: adhiṭṭhahati, adhiṭṭheti, adhimuccati, abhinīharati, niyāmeti, sañcintayati, saṃcintayati

examples.text: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.

41543.meaning1: makes a wish; hopes for; prays for

examples.text: so tassa kāyaduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati. mā maṃ jaññū'ti icchati, mā maṃ jaññū'ti saṅkappati, mā maṃ jaññū'ti vācaṃ bhāsati, mā maṃ jaññū'ti kāyena parakkamati.
tassa kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahato pāmojjaṃ jāyati

41545.meaning2: aspired to, longed for, put forth, directed

examples.text: yassa khv'āhaṃ atthāya cittaṃ paṇidahiṃ so me attho abhinipphanno

41546.meaning2: aspired to, longed for, put forth, directed

41547.meaning1: should be guided; can be directed; should be determined; can be intended; can be aimed
41547.commentary: (SNa) kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahitabban'ti evaṃ kilesapariḷāhe ca līnatte ca bahiddhāvikkhepe ca uppanne kiles'ānurañjitena na vattitabbaṃ, kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye pasād'āvahe buddh'ādīsu aññatarasmiṃ ṭhāne kammaṭṭhānacittaṃ ṭhapetabbaṃ.

examples.text: ten'ānanda, bhikkhunā kismiñci'd'eva pasādanīye nimitte cittaṃ paṇidahitabbaṃ.

41548.meaning2: having aspired to, having longed for, having put forth, having directed

examples.text: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.

41551.meaning1: due to making an aspiration; based on intention (for the future)

examples.text: iti me cakkhu siyā anāgatam'addhānaṃ iti rūpā'ti, appaṭiladdhassa paṭilābhāya cittaṃ paṇidahati, cetaso paṇidhānapaccayā tadabhinandati, tadabhinandanto anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
evaṃ kho, ānanda, paṇidhāya bhāvanā hoti
tato paṭinivattitvā aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye, sataṃ sahassānaṃ nirabbudānaṃ, chattiṃsatī pañca ca abbudāni, yam'ariyagarahī nirayaṃ upeti, vācaṃ manañ'ca paṇidhāya pāpakan'ti.

41554.meaning1: aimed (at); with the intention (towards); with an aspiration (for)

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhu, amanussaggāho? idha, bhikkhu, ekacco aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti.

yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imin'āhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi dev'aññataro vā'ti, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.

41555.commentary: (MNa) paṇidhāyā'ti aṅgārakāsuyaṃ patthanā nāma n'atthi, aṅgārakāsuṃ ārabbha pana iriyāpathassa ṭhapitattā evaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghamm'ābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito ek'āyanena maggena tam'eva aṅgārakāsuṃ paṇidhāya.

41556.commentary: (THa) paṇidhī me na vijjatī'ti imesaṃ abhiññāvisesānaṃ atthāya parikammavasena cittassa paṇidhi citt'ābhinīhāro me n'atthi n'āhosī'ti attho. sabbaññuguṇā viya hi buddhānaṃ aggamagg'ādhigamen'eva sāvakānaṃ sabbe sāvakaguṇā hatthagatā honti, na tesaṃ adhigamāya visuṃ parikammakaraṇakiccaṃ atthī'ti.

examples.text: n'eva pubbenivāsāya, na'pi dibbassa cakkhuno, cetopariyāya iddhiyā, cutiyā upapattiyā, sotadhātuvisuddhiyā, paṇidhī me na vijjati.

41557.meaning1: (comm) fulfilling one's obligation upon the fulfilment of a wish
41557.commentary: (DNa) santikamman'ti devaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā sace me idaṃ nāma samijjhissati, tumhākaṃ iminā ca iminā ca upahāraṃ karissāmī'ti samiddhikāle kattabbaṃ santipaṭissavakammaṃ. tasmiṃ pana samiddhe tassa karaṇaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ nāma

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, santikammaṃ paṇidhikammaṃ bhūtakammaṃ bhūrikammaṃ vassakammaṃ vossakammaṃ vatthukammaṃ vatthuparikammaṃ ācamanaṃ nhāpanaṃ juhanaṃ

41558.meaning1: sets (one's heart); directs (one's mind); forms (an intention)

examples.text: tāvatiṃsā ca yāmā ca, tusitā c'āpi devatā, nimmānaratino devā, ye devā vasavattino, tattha cittaṃ paṇidhehi, ratiṃ paccanubhossasī'ti.

41559.meaning1: deep bow; prostration; falling at the feet; humble submission
41559.commentary: (ITIa) paṇipāto nāma ajja ādiṃ katvā ahaṃ abhivādana-paccuṭṭhāna-añjalikamma-sāmīcikammaṃ buddh'ādīnaṃ eva tiṇṇaṃ vatthūnaṃ karomi iti maṃ dhāretū'ti evaṃ buddh'ādīsu paramanipaccakāro. imesañ'hi catunnaṃ ākārānaṃ aññataraṃ karontena gahitaṃ eva hoti saraṇagamanaṃ.

41560.commentary: (ANa) assapaṇiyaṃ poseyyā'ti pañca assapotasatāni kiṇitvā pacchā vikkiṇissāmī'ti poseyya.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, puriso uday'atthiko assapaṇiyaṃ poseyya. so udayañ'c'eva n'ādhigaccheyya, uttariñ'ca kilamathassa vighātassa bhāgī assa. evam'evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, uday'atthiko bāle nigaṇṭhe payirupāsiṃ.

41561.meaning1: goods; wares; item to be sold

examples.text: tena hi, bho, yān'amhākaṃ satthe appasārāni paṇiyāni, tāni chaḍḍetvā, yāni imasmiṃ satthe mahāsārāni paṇiyāni, tāni ādiyathā'ti.

41563.meaning2: aspired to, longed for, put forth, directed, bent on, intent

examples.text: yathā yathā vā pan'assa kāyo paṇihito hoti tathā tathā naṃ pajānāti
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ yathāṭhitaṃ yathāpaṇihitaṃ dhātuso paccavekkhati atthi imasmiṃ kāye pathavīdhātu āpodhātu tejodhātu vāyodhātū'ti

41564.meaning2: desire to which one is disposed

examples.text: yathā imassa bhoto manosaṅkhārā paṇihitā. tathā imassa cittassa anantarā imaṃ nāma vitakkaṃ vitakkessatī'ti.
atha kho brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi, kālo, bho gotama, niṭṭhitaṃ bhattan'ti.
yam'pi no saddhā gahapatikā divā vikāle paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā denti, tatra'p'ime mukh'āvaraṇaṃ maññe karontī'ti.
yaṃ kiñci vittaṃ idha vā huraṃ vā, saggesu vā yaṃ ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, na no samaṃ atthi tathāgatena, idam'pi buddhe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

so, bhikkhave, samayo yaṃ taṃ cittaṃ ajjhattaṃ'y'eva santiṭṭhati sannisīdati ekodi hoti samādhiyati. so hoti samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāv'ādhigato na sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato.

41569.meaning1: leading to the superior; going to the sublime

examples.text: paṇītañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi paṇītagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

41570.meaning2: due to the refined meditation state

41571.meaning1: more sublime; more refined; more delicious (than)

examples.text: etadānuttariyaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇānaṃ yadidaṃ tattha tattha yathābhūtañāṇaṃ. etasmā c'āhaṃ, ānanda, ñāṇā aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā n'atthī'ti vadāmi
imesaṃ kho, potaliya, catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ katamo te puggalo khamati abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?

41572.meaning1: more excellent fruit of the spiritual life
41572.meaning2: more excellent fruit of the spiritual life

41574.meaning1: giving fine things; who donates superior gifts; (comm) giving delicious flavoured food

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ paṇītadāyakānaṃ yadidaṃ mahānāmo sakko.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā.

41575.commentary: (DNa) hīn'ādīsu hīnā dhātū'ti dvādasa akusalacittuppādā. avasesā tebhūmakadhammā majjhimadhātu. nava lok'uttaradhammā paṇītadhātu.

examples.text: aparā'pi tisso dhātuyo, hīnadhātu, majjhimadhātu, paṇītadhātu.

41576.meaning1: more and more refined; more and more sublime
41576.commentary: (MNa) uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītan'ti uttar'uttariṃ c'eva paṇītatarañ'ca katvā deseti.

examples.text: evaṃvādiṃ kho, bhikkhave, satthāraṃ arahati sāvako upasaṅkamituṃ dhammassavanāya. tassa satthā dhammaṃ deseti uttar'uttariṃ paṇītapaṇītaṃ kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāgaṃ.

41578.meaning1: fine food; superior food; luxury food

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni paṇītabhojanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, sappi, navanītaṃ, telaṃ, madhu, phāṇitaṃ, maccho, maṃsaṃ, khīraṃ, dadhi. yo pana bhikkhu evarūpāni paṇītabhojanāni agilāno attano atthāya viññāpetvā bhuñjeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
agilāno nāma yassa vinā paṇītabhojanāni phāsu hoti.

41580.meaning1: this is sublime; this is refined

examples.text: avijjāya tv'eva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santam'etaṃ padaṃ paṇītam'etaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ, sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.

41582.meaning1: considered more delicious; thought to be tastier

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, ahu'd'eva aññathattaṃ ahu'd'eva domanassaṃ, yam'pi no imesaṃ dvinnaṃ bhattānaṃ paṇītasaṅkhātataraṃ tassa'pi no bhagavā pahānam'āha, tassa'pi no sugato paṭinissaggam'āhā'ti.

41583.meaning1: refined disposition; superior inclination; good tendency
41583.commentary: (VMVt) yāya dussīl'ādike hīn'ādhimuttike sevanti, sā hīn'ādhimutti. yāya paṇīt'ādhimuttike sevanti, sā paṇīt'ādhimutti. taṃ duvidham'pi adhimuttiṃ bhagavā sabb'ākārato jānāti.

examples.text: adhimutti ajjhāsayadhātu. sā duvidhā hīn'ādhimutti paṇīt'ādhimuttī'ti. yāya hīn'ādhimuttikā sattā hīn'ādhimuttike'y'eva sevanti, paṇītādhimuttikā ca paṇīt'ādhimuttike'y'eva.

41584.meaning1: aiming for the finest; resolved on the sublime; (comm) intent on Nibbāna
41584.commentary: (PMa) paṇīt'ādhimuttikā'ti kalyāṇ'ajjhāsayā. (ANt) paṇīt'ādhimuttiko'ti paṇīte uttame maggaphale adhimutto ninnapoṇapabbhāro. (VISMa) paṇīt'ādhimuttiko hoti nibbān'ādhimuttattā.

41585.commentary: (THIa) cittaṃ paṇīdhehī'ti tasmiṃ tāvatiṃsādike devanikāye tava cittaṃ ṭhapehi, upapajjanāya nikantiṃ karohi.

examples.text: padakkhiṇaṃ kāyakammaṃ, vācākammaṃ padakkhiṇaṃ, padakkhiṇaṃ manokammaṃ paṇīdhi te padakkhiṇe. padakkhiṇāni katvāna, labhant'atthe padakkhiṇe.

41586.meaning1: being driven out; being expelled; being rejected; being pushed away; being forced away
41586.commentary: (MNa) api panujjamānenā'pī'ti api nikkaḍḍhīyamānen'āpi. evarūpo hi puggalo sace'pi dārukalāpasataṃ vā udakaghaṭasataṃ vā vālikambaṇasataṃ vā daṇḍaṃ āharāpeti, mā idha vasī'ti nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, taṃ taṃ khamāpetvā yāvajīvaṃ vatthabbam'evā'ti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, ānanda, kaṃ atthavasaṃ sampassamāno arahati sāvako satthāraṃ anubandhituṃ api paṇujjamāno'ti ?

dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

41588.meaning1: eliminated individual (interpretations of the) truth; removed personal (versions of the) truth
41588.commentary: (NIDD1a) paṇunnapaccekasacco'ti idam'eva dassanaṃ saccaṃ, idam'eva saccan'ti evaṃ pāṭiekkaṃ gahitattā paccekasaṅkhātāni diṭṭhisaccāni paṇunnāni nihaṭāni pahīnāni assā'ti paṇunnapaccekasacco.

examples.text: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

41589.meaning1: (of fine or punishment) imposes; inflicts; exacts

examples.text: apuññalābho ca gatī ca pāpikā, bhītassa bhītāya ratī ca thokikā, rājā ca daṇḍaṃ garukaṃ paṇeti, tasmā naro paradāraṃ na seve.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, coraṃ āgucāriṃ gahetvā rañño dasseyyuṃ, ayaṃ te, deva, coro āgucārī, imassa yaṃ icchasi taṃ daṇḍaṃ paṇehī'ti

41590.meaning2: having counted, having reckoned, having decreed (a fine or punishment)

41592.commentary: (MNa) paṇ'opaṇaviyā'ti paṇaviyā ca opaṇaviyā ca. na upetī'ti na hoti. kayavikkayakāle viya agghavaḍḍhanahāpanaṃ na hotī'ti attho. ayaṃ goṇo kiṃ agghati, vīsati agghatī'ti bhaṇanto paṇati nāma. na vīsati agghati, dasa agghatī'ti bhaṇanto opaṇati nāma. idaṃ paṭisedhento āha paṇ'opaṇaviyā na upetī'ti. idāni taṃ paṇ'opaṇaviyaṃ dassetuṃ evañ'ca no assa, atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no evam'assa, na naṃ kareyyāmā'ti āha. (MNt) paṇena vohārena byākaraṇaṃ paṇaviyā, paṇaviyā abhāvena opaṇaviyā

examples.text: yo'pi so, bhikkhave, satthā āmisagaru āmisadāy'ādo āmisehi saṃsaṭṭho viharati tassa pāyaṃ evarūpī paṇ'opaṇaviyā na upeti, evañ'ca no assa atha naṃ kareyyāma, na ca no evam'assa na naṃ kareyyāmā'ti, kiṃ pana, bhikkhave, yaṃ tathāgato sabbaso āmisehi visaṃsaṭṭho viharati.

41593.commentary: (VINa) paṇḍako bhikkhave'ti ettha āsittapaṇḍako usūyapaṇḍako opakkamikapaṇḍako pakkhapaṇḍako napuṃsakapaṇḍako'ti pañca paṇḍakā. tattha yassa paresaṃ aṅgajātaṃ mukhena gahetvā asucinā āsittassa pariḷāho vūpasammati, ayaṃ āsittapaṇḍako. yassa paresaṃ ajjhācāraṃ passato usūyāya uppannāya pariḷāho vūpasammati, ayaṃ usūyapaṇḍako. yassa upakkamena bījāni apanītāni, ayaṃ opakkamikapaṇḍako. ekacco pana akusalavipāk'ānubhāvena kāḷapakkhe paṇḍako hoti, juṇhapakkhe pan'assa pariḷāho vūpasammati, ayaṃ pakkhapaṇḍako. yo pana paṭisandhiyaṃ'y'eva abhāvako uppanno, ayaṃ napuṃsakapaṇḍako'ti. tesu āsittapaṇḍakassa ca usūyapaṇḍakassa ca pabbajjā na vāritā, itaresaṃ tiṇṇaṃ vāritā. tesu'pi pakkhapaṇḍakassa yasmiṃ pakkhe paṇḍako hoti, tasmiṃ'y'evassa pakkhe pabbajjā vāritā'ti kurundiyaṃ vuttaṃ. yassa c'ettha pabbajjā vāritā, taṃ sandhāya idaṃ vuttaṃ, anupasampanno na upasampādetabbo upasampanno nāsetabbo'ti. so'pi liṅganāsanen'eva nāsetabbo. ito paraṃ nāsetabbo'ti vuttesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: vajjanīyā ca puggalā tasmiṃ na honti kiṃ? gahaṭṭhapaṇḍaka'ādayo ekavīsati vajjanīyā puggalā hatthapāsato bahikaraṇavasena vajjetabbā. te asmiṃ na honti.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: yakkhiyā vā petiyā vā paṇḍakena vā tiracchānagatāya vā manussaviggah'itthiyā vā saddhiṃ raho paṭicchanne āsane nisajjaṃ kappeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. amātugāme mātugāmasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
katamehi pañcahi? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vesiyāgocaro vā hoti, vidhavāgocaro vā hoti, thullakumārikāgocaro vā hoti, paṇḍakagocaro vā hoti, bhikkhunīgocaro vā hoti.

41596.meaning1: perceiving as asexual; regarding as neuter

examples.text: itthī ca hoti paṇḍakasaññī sāratto ca. bhikkhu ca naṃ itthiyā kāyena kāyaṃ āmasati parāmasati … gaṇhāti chupati, āpatti thull'accayassa.
yadā balākā sucipaṇḍaracchadā, kāḷassa meghassa bhayena tajjitā, palehiti ālayam'ālay'esinī, tadā nadī ajakaraṇī rame'ti maṃ.
dubhayāni viceyya paṇḍarāni, ajjhattaṃ bahiddhā ca suddhipañño, kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ upātivatto, paṇḍito tādi pavuccate tathattā.
